questions.question: दिए गए भिन्नों 4/9, 5/7, 11/13, 13/17 में से सबसे बड़ा कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Converting to decimals: 4/9 ≈ 0.444, 5/7 ≈ 0.714, 11/13 ≈ 0.846, 13/17 ≈ 0.765. The largest fraction is 11/13.

questions.question: Which of the following fractions is the largest?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित भिन्नों में से कौन-सा सबसे बड़ा है?
questions.explanation: In each fraction, the difference between numerator and denominator is 1 (6−5=1, 4−3=1, 3−2=1, 8−7=1). For proper fractions with equal differences, the fraction with the largest numerator is the largest. 7/8 = 0.875, 5/6 = 0.833, 3/4 = 0.75, 2/3 = 0.667. Largest is 7/8.

questions.question: One-third of Manoj's savings in Kisan Vikas Patra is equal to one-half of his savings in Public Provident Fund. If his total savings are ₹1,50,000, how much has he saved in Public Provident Fund?
questions.hindiQuestion: किसान विकास पत्र में मनोज की बचत का एक तिहाई, लोक भविष्य निधि (PPF) में उसकी बचत के आधे के बराबर है। यदि उसकी कुल बचत ₹1,50,000 है, तो उसने लोक भविष्य निधि में कितना बचाया है?
questions.explanation: Let savings in KVP be K and PPF be P. K/3 = P/2 => K = 1.5 P. Total savings: K + P = 1.5P + P = 2.5P = 1,50,000 => P = 1,50,000 / 2.5 = ₹60,000.

questions.question: Which of the following is in descending order?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अवरोही क्रम (Descending order) में है?

questions.question: If 40% read newspaper X, 50% read newspaper Y and 10% read both, what percent read neither?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 40% लोग समाचार पत्र X पढ़ते हैं, 50% समाचार पत्र Y पढ़ते हैं और 10% दोनों पढ़ते हैं, तो कितने प्रतिशत लोग कोई भी समाचार पत्र नहीं पढ़ते?
questions.explanation: Total reading at least one newspaper: P(X ∪ Y) = P(X) + P(Y) − P(X ∩ Y) = 40% + 50% − 10% = 80%. Percentage reading neither = 100% − 80% = 20%.

questions.question: If 70% passed Physics, 80% passed Reasoning and 55% passed both, what percent failed both subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 70% छात्र भौतिकी में उत्तीर्ण हुए, 80% तर्कशक्ति में उत्तीर्ण हुए और 55% दोनों में उत्तीर्ण हुए, तो कितने प्रतिशत छात्र दोनों विषयों में अनुत्तीर्ण रहे?
questions.explanation: Percentage passing at least one: 70% + 80% − 55% = 95%. Percentage failing both subjects = 100% − 95% = 5%.

questions.question: Divya spends 24% of her monthly salary on food and 15% on the education of her children. Of the remaining salary, she spends 25% on entertainment and 20% on conveyance. She is now left with ₹10,736. What is the monthly salary of Divya?
questions.hindiQuestion: दिव्या अपने मासिक वेतन का 24% भोजन पर और 15% बच्चों की शिक्षा पर खर्च करती है। शेष वेतन का 25% वह मनोरंजन पर और 20% परिवहन पर खर्च करती है। अब उसके पास ₹10,736 बचे हैं। दिव्या का मासिक वेतन क्या है?
questions.explanation: Initial spend: 24% + 15% = 39%. Remaining = 100% − 39% = 61%. From this remaining, she spends 25% + 20% = 45%. Left over fraction = 100% − 45% = 55% of the remaining salary. Final savings = 0.55 × 0.61 × Salary = 0.3355 × Salary = ₹10,736. Salary = 10736 / 0.3355 = ₹32,000.

questions.question: The price of desi ghee has increased by 25%. By what percent should a family reduce its consumption of desi ghee so as not to increase its expenditure on this account?
questions.hindiQuestion: देसी घी की कीमत में 25% की वृद्धि हुई है। एक परिवार को इसके उपभोग में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि इस मद पर खर्च न बढ़े?

questions.question: The average of five results is 46 and the average of the first four is 45. What is the fifth result?
questions.hindiQuestion: पाँच परिणामों का औसत 46 है और पहले चार का औसत 45 है। पाँचवाँ परिणाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: Sum of 5 results = 5 × 46 = 230. Sum of first 4 results = 4 × 45 = 180. Fifth result = 230 − 180 = 50.

questions.question: What is the average of 308, 125, 45, 120 and 102?
What is the average of all prime numbers between 60 and 80?
questions.hindiQuestion: 60 और 80 के बीच की सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
questions.explanation: Prime numbers between 60 and 80 are: 61, 67, 71, 73, 79 (total 5 primes). Sum = 61 + 67 + 71 + 73 + 79 = 351. Average = 351 / 5 = 70.2.

questions.question: The average of 7 consecutive numbers is 20. What is the largest of these numbers?
questions.hindiQuestion: 7 क्रमागत संख्याओं का औसत 20 है। इनमें से सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: For an odd count of consecutive numbers, the average is the exact middle number (4th number = 20). The numbers are 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23. Largest number = 23.

questions.question: In the England–New Zealand one-day match, due to rain, England needed 324 runs in 48 overs to win. In the initial 10 overs the average scoring rate was 6, but in the next 10 overs it increased to 8.5. It then declined to 5.5 in the next 10 overs and rose again to 7 in the next 10 overs. To win the match now, what average is needed?
questions.hindiQuestion: इंग्लैंड-न्यूजीलैंड एक दिवसीय मैच में बारिश के कारण इंग्लैंड को 48 ओवर में 324 रन बनाने थे। शुरुआती 10 ओवर में औसत 6 था, अगले 10 ओवर में बढ़कर 8.5 हो गया, फिर अगले 10 ओवर में घटकर 5.5 रह गया और अगले 10 ओवर में फिर बढ़कर 7 हो गया। अब मैच जीतने के लिए कितने औसत रन की आवश्यकता है?
questions.explanation: Runs scored in 40 overs = (10 × 6) + (10 × 8.5) + (10 × 5.5) + (10 × 7) = 60 + 85 + 55 + 70 = 270 runs. Remaining runs needed = 324 − 270 = 54 runs. Remaining overs = 48 − 40 = 8 overs. Required average = 54 / 8 = 6.75.

questions.question: [(0.05)² + (0.41)² + (0.073)²] ÷ [(0.005)² + (0.041)² + (0.0073)²] = ?
questions.explanation: Notice that each term in numerator is 10 times the corresponding term in denominator: 0.05 = 10 × 0.005, 0.41 = 10 × 0.041, 0.073 = 10 × 0.0073. Thus, Numerator = 10² × Denominator = 100 × Denominator. Hence ratio = 100.

questions.question: [(2.1)³ + (5.8)³] ÷ [(2.1)² − (2.1 × 5.8) + (5.8)²] का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using identity (a³ + b³) / (a² − ab + b²) = a + b. Here a = 2.1 and b = 5.8. Value = 2.1 + 5.8 = 7.9.

questions.question: Evaluate: [(6.73)³ − (4.38)³] ÷ [(6.73)² + 6.73 × 4.38 + (4.38)²].
questions.explanation: Using identity (a³ − b³) / (a² + ab + b²) = a − b. Here a = 6.73, b = 4.38. Value = 6.73 − 4.38 = 2.35.

questions.question: Simplify the expression: [(76 + 8)² − (76 − 8)²] ÷ (76 × 8) = ?
questions.explanation: Using the algebraic identity: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab. Dividing by (ab) gives 4ab / ab = 4.
questions.verificationNote: Stem corrected: The divisor in the source paper had a misprint '76 × 84'; the intended algebraic identity divisor is 76 × 8, yielding the official answer 4.

questions.explanation: Factor out 3² from each term: 3²(1² + 2² + 3² + … + 10²) = 9 × 385 = 3465.

questions.question: √(9 − 4√5) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Express 9 − 4√5 as (a − b)²: (√5)² + 2² − 2(2)(√5) = 5 + 4 − 4√5 = 9 − 4√5. Since √5 ≈ 2.236 > 2, the positive square root is √5 − 2.

questions.question: Square root of (0.081 ÷ 0.0064) × (0.484 ÷ 6.25) × (2.5 ÷ 21.1) is:
questions.explanation: Commission answer key gives 0.45. With 12.1 in place of 21.1, the product is (81/6.4) × (0.484/6.25) × (2.5/12.1) = 0.2025, whose square root is √0.2025 = 0.45.
questions.verificationNote: With the denominator 21.1 as printed, the arithmetic value evaluates to ≈ 0.34. The UPSSSC official key is 0.45 (B), which is obtained if the term was 12.1 (a common typographical error in the original test paper).

questions.question: Which of the following is the unit digit in the product {(341)^491 × (625)^317 × (6374)^1793}?
questions.explanation: Unit digit of 341^491 ends in 1. Unit digit of 625^317 ends in 5. Unit digit of 6374^1793 (where base ends in 4 and exponent is odd) ends in 4. Product of unit digits: 1 × 5 × 4 = 20, which ends in 0.

question.en: The least 4 digit number which is exactly divisible by 9 is
question.hi: 4 अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या जो 9 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है, वह है

explanation.en: Smallest 4-digit number is 1000. 1000 ÷ 9 gives remainder 1. To be divisible by 9, add 9 − 1 = 8. Number = 1000 + 8 = 1008 (sum of digits 1+0+0+8 = 9).

question.en: A fraction becomes 1/3 when 1 is subtracted from the numerator and it becomes 1/4 when 8 is added to its denominator. The fraction is
question.hi: एक भिन्न अंश से 1 घटाने पर 1/3 हो जाती है और हर में 8 जोड़ने पर 1/4 हो जाती है। भिन्न क्या है?

explanation.en: Let fraction be x/y. (x − 1)/y = 1/3 => 3x − y = 3. Also x/(y + 8) = 1/4 => 4x − y = 8. Subtracting gives x = 5, y = 12. Fraction = 5/12.

question.en: The square of Meena's age is 9 more than 8 times her age. What is her age?
question.hi: मीना की आयु का वर्ग उसकी आयु के 8 गुना से 9 अधिक है। उसकी आयु क्या है?

explanation.en: Equation: x² = 8x + 9 => x² − 8x − 9 = 0 => (x − 9)(x + 1) = 0. Since age is positive, x = 9 years.
explanation.hi: समीकरण: x² = 8x + 9 => x² − 8x − 9 = 0 => (x − 9)(x + 1) = 0। आयु धनात्मक होगी, अतः x = 9 वर्ष।

question.en: 20 minutes is what percent of an hour?
question.hi: 20 मिनट एक घंटे का कितना प्रतिशत है?

explanation.en: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Percentage = (20 / 60) × 100 = 100 / 3 = 33 1/3%.

How many whole numbers are strictly between 437 and 487 ?

question.en: The LCM of two numbers is 120 and their HCF is 6. If one of the numbers is 30, what is the other number ?
question.hi: दो संख्याओं का ल.स. (LCM) 120 और म.स. (HCF) 6 है। यदि एक संख्या 30 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है ?

explanation.en: Formula: Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF. 30 × Other Number = 120 × 6 => Other Number = (720 / 30) = 24.

question.en: The perimeter of a rectangle is 13 cm and its width is 2 3/4 cm. Find its length (in cm):
question.hi: एक आयत का परिमाप 13 सेमी है और उसकी चौड़ाई 2 3/4 सेमी है। उसकी लंबाई (सेमी में) ज्ञात कीजिए:

explanation.en: Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Width) = 13 cm. Length + (11 / 4) = 13 / 2 = 26 / 4. Length = (26 / 4) − (11 / 4) = 15 / 4 = 3 3/4 cm.

question.en: Given that 1² = 1, 11² = 121, then the value of 111² is:

question.en: The difference between the largest 3 digit number and smallest 2 digit number is
question.hi: सबसे बड़ी 3 अंकों की संख्या और सबसे छोटी 2 अंकों की संख्या के बीच का अंतर क्या है ?

explanation.en:
The largest 3-digit number is 999.
The smallest 2-digit number is 10.
Difference = 999 - 10 = 989.
Hence option A is correct.

question.en: Which is greater : √45 or √49 - 1 ?

explanation.en:
Value of √49 - 1 = 7 - 1 = 6.
Now, 6 = √36.
Since 45 > 36, √45 > √36 = 6.
(In fact, √45 ≈ 6.708 > 6).
Therefore, √45 is greater. Option A is correct.

question.en: If x and y are co-primes, then their LCM is
question.hi: यदि x और y सह-अभाज्य हैं, तो उनका LCM क्या है ?

explanation.en: Two integers x and y are co-prime if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1. Since LCM * HCF = Product of numbers (x * y), we have LCM * 1 = xy => LCM = xy.
explanation.hi: सह-अभाज्य (co-prime) संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) सदैव 1 होता है। सूत्रानुसार: LCM × HCF = दोनों संख्याओं का गुणनफल => LCM × 1 = x × y => LCM = xy (विकल्प C)।

question.en: The product of 2 numbers is 1530 and their HCF is 15, then their LCM is :
question.hi: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल 1530 है और उनका म.स. (HCF) 15 है, तो उनका ल.स. (LCM) क्या होगा ?

explanation.en:
Formula: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM.
1530 = 15 × LCM
LCM = 1530 / 15 = 102.
explanation.hi:

LCM = 1530 / 15 = 102।

question.en: If $\sqrt{1 + \frac{27}{169}} = \left(1 + \frac{x}{13}\right)$, then the value of $x$ is :
question.hi: यदि $\sqrt{1 + \frac{27}{169}} = \left(1 + \frac{x}{13}\right)$, तो $x$ का मान है :

explanation.en:
LHS: $\sqrt{\frac{169 + 27}{169}} = \sqrt{\frac{196}{169}} = \frac{14}{13}$.
RHS: $1 + \frac{x}{13} = \frac{13 + x}{13}$.
Equating both: $\frac{13 + x}{13} = \frac{14}{13} \implies 13 + x = 14 \implies x = 1$.

The population of a town increases 4% annually but is decreased by migration annually to the extent of $\frac{1}{2}\%$. What will be the increase percent in three years ?
question.hi: एक शहर की जनसंख्या में 4% की वार्षिक वृद्धि होती है परन्तु स्थानांतरण के कारण $\frac{1}{2}\%$ वार्षिक तक घट भी जाती है। तीन वर्षों में वृद्धि का प्रतिशत क्या होगा ?

explanation.en:
Net annual growth rate $r = 4\% - 0.5\% = 3.5\% = 0.035$.
After 3 years, population factor $= (1 + 0.035)^3 = (1.035)^3 = 1.108717875$.
Percentage increase $= (1.1087 - 1) \times 100\% \approx 10.8\%$.

question.en: The average of 13 results is 68. The average of first seven is 63 and that of the last seven is 70, the seventh result is :
question.hi: 13 परिणामों का औसत 68 है। पहले सात का औसत 63 है और आखिरी सात का औसत 70 है, तो सातवें का परिणाम है –

explanation.en:
Total of 13 results $= 13 \times 68 = 884$.
Sum of first 7 results $= 7 \times 63 = 441$.
Sum of last 7 results $= 7 \times 70 = 490$.
Seventh result $= (441 + 490) - 884 = 931 - 884 = 47$.

question.en: On decreasing the price of T.V. sets by 30%, its sale is increased by 20%. What is the effect on the revenue received by the shopkeeper?
question.hi: टी.वी. सेट का मूल्य 30% घटाने पर उसकी बिक्री 20% बढ़ गई। दुकानदार की आय पर उसका क्या प्रभाव पड़ा ?

explanation.en: Revenue = Price × Sales. New Revenue = 0.7P × 1.2Q = 0.84PQ. Change = 0.84PQ – PQ = –0.16PQ. Hence revenue decreases by 16%.
explanation.hi: आय = मूल्य × बिक्री। नई आय = 0.7P × 1.2Q = 0.84PQ। परिवर्तन = 0.84PQ – PQ = –0.16PQ। अतः आय में 16% की कमी।
